scenicChapters.title: Jebel Hafeet Mountain Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 49 km this is Jebel Hafeet Mountain Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-hili-oasis-jebel-hafit-desert-par.story: 131 km from Al Buraymī to Al Buraymī, about 2 h 16 of riding. On the way it passes Bidaa Bint Saud, Jebel Hafit Desert Park and back through Bidaa Bint Saud. Dry, open country - carry water.
